title: Truth and Reconciliation Commission of the Republic of Korea: Consolidated Report
authors: Truth and Reconciliation Commission of Korea (TRCK)
publisher_or_archive: Government of the Republic of Korea, Seoul
summary: Official state truth commission investigation uncovering systematic mass executions of an estimated 100,000 to 200,000 South Korean suspected leftists and political prisoners during the Bodo League massacres of 1950, executed by South Korean military police and intelligence units operating under the wartime operational command of US General Douglas MacArthur.
